post.summary: Find a LinkedIn company URL from a domain
post.description: Accepts only a company domain and returns only its LinkedIn company URL. Use a current workspace API key from Airscale Settings; keys from the previous dashboard are not supported. The lookup deadline is 120 seconds; allow 130 seconds in the client. The charge may appear after the result, including after a top-up if your balance is insufficient.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 0.5 credits on success; the charge may appear later, including after a top-up. No-result and failed lookups cost zero.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Use the same key for transport retries of the same domain. Stored responses replay for seven days without another lookup or charge. In-flight duplicates return 409 with Retry-After: 2. Reusing a key with a different domain or after expiry returns 409. A new key starts a new operation. Without a key every request is a new operation.

requestBody.description: Exactly one domain field. Maximum JSON body size: 4 KiB.

domain.description: A company hostname without scheme, path, port, or credentials. Case and a leading www. are normalized.

200.description: A canonical LinkedIn company URL. Costs 0.5 credits; the charge may appear later.

400.description: Invalid JSON, domain, extra body fields, or Idempotency-Key.

404.description: No matching LinkedIn company URL found. Not charged.

409.description: Operation in progress, key reused for a different domain, or expired key. Retry in-flight operations with the same key; use a new key for conflicts or expiry.

Retry-After.description: Present for an in-flight duplicate: retry after 2 seconds.

413.description: JSON request body exceeds 4 KiB.

429.description: 180 requests per minute per workspace exceeded. Retry with bounded backoff.

503.description: The lookup is temporarily unavailable. Retry according to the idempotency guidance.

post.summary: Find a profile from an email
post.description: Resolves a public person profile from an email address, or returns the JSON string "not found" when no profile is available. A match usually returns a nested person record with camelCase keys: names are under profile (profile.firstName, profile.lastName), not at the top level. A match from a fallback lookup uses the flat fields of POST /v1/profile instead, or contains only url and identifier.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 2 credits only when a profile is returned; "not found" and errors are not charged.

requestBody.description: The email is trimmed and lowercased before lookup. It must have a non-empty local part, an @ sign, and a domain containing a dot.

200.description: A public person profile or the exact JSON string "not found".

requestBody.description: Provide at least one real company filter. Defaults such as eventWindow and locationMatch do not count as filters.

country.description: Matches a recognized country name or ISO alpha-2 code.

region.description: Matches a canonical region code, Region|Country value, or a region name scoped by country. Discover canonical values with GET /v1/find-companies/filter-values.

city.description: Matches a resolvable city value. Discover accepted values with GET /v1/find-companies/filter-values.

industry.description: Matches a canonical company industry. Discover accepted values with GET /v1/find-companies/filter-values.

locations.description: Matches a fixed range for the number of company locations.

eventWindow.description: Sets the recent-event window. Null or blank values use the default 30 days.

locationMatch.description: Controls whether location filters match headquarters only or headquarters and operating locations. Null or blank values use the default hqOnly.

Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import os
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "https://api.airscale.io/v1/find-companies/filter-values",
    headers={"Authorization": f'Bearer {os.environ["AIRSCALE_API_KEY"]}'},
    params={"filter": "industry", "q": "example"},
    timeout=30,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The Find Companies filter whose accepted values should be discovered.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At least one of q or query is required and must contain 2 to 120 characters after trimming. When q is present it is read first; a blank q suppresses query and returns 400.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: At least one of q or query is required and must contain 2 to 120 characters after trimming. query is used only when q is absent.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Omitted, non-numeric, or non-integer values default to 20; an explicit empty value becomes 0 then clamps to 1; integers below 1 clamp to 1; integers above 100 clamp to 100.

parameters.description: Optional country context supplied as repeat or comma-separated values.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Optional region context supplied as repeat or comma-separated values; a bare region name needs country context.

post.description: Finds companies similar to 1–10 reference domains and returns a synchronous JSON response. Authenticate with a current-app workspace API key. The JSON body is limited to 128 KiB. Every POST is an independent, potentially billable search; do not automatically retry after a lost response. There is no pagination, polling, or result-retrieval endpoint. Allow at least 100 seconds for the client timeout; the server has a 90-second overall budget.
post.x-airscale-rate-limit: 5 requests per rolling minute per workspace. Maximum 1 active search per workspace.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 0.5 credits per unique returned company. Reserves limit × 0.5 credits before searching and refunds the unused amount. Empty results cost zero credits.

domains.description: Reference company websites, normalized to domains and deduplicated. Accepts domains or website URLs, not LinkedIn URLs or IP addresses. Reference companies are excluded from results.

limit.description: Total unique results across all references, not per domain. Maximum min(5000, 2000 × distinct normalized reference domains): 2000 for one, 4000 for two, 5000 for three through ten. Searches may return fewer results.

country.description: Country names or ISO alpha-2 codes. Codes are normalized before searching.

city.description: City names. A location filter that cannot be resolved can return HTTP 422.

simple.summary: Find up to ten similar companies

relevance_score.description: Available relevance score, or null. Not a confidence percentage and not guaranteed to be between 0 and 1.

matched_domains.description: Normalized reference domains that matched this company.

warnings.description: Partial reference failures or omitted invalid websites. Empty when no warnings occurred.

post.description: Returns one page of up to 50 LinkedIn posts matching keywords, author, mention, group, content-type, and date filters. Costs 1 credit per successful request.
post.x-airscale-rate-limit: 180 requests per fixed minute per workspace, counted separately for each LinkedIn content endpoint; pagination requests and retries count.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 1 credit per successful request, including empty pages; invalid input and failed requests are not charged.

requestBody.description: Search filters and an optional cursor. The JSON body must not exceed 16 KiB.

schema.description: Provide `keywords` or at least one author, mention, or group filter. All provided filters combine.

keywords.description: Words to search for in posts.

author_profile_urls.description: Posts written by these LinkedIn profiles (linkedin.com/in/...). A string or an array of up to 10 values.

author_company_urls.description: Posts published by these company pages, as LinkedIn company URLs or numeric company IDs. A string or an array of up to 10 values.

author_employer_company_urls.description: Posts whose authors work at these companies, as LinkedIn company URLs or numeric company IDs. A string or an array of up to 10 values.

author_industry_ids.description: Authors' company industry, as numeric LinkedIn industry IDs. A value or an array of up to 10 values.

mentioning_profile_urls.description: Posts that mention these LinkedIn profiles. A string or an array of up to 10 values.

mentioning_company_urls.description: Posts that mention these companies, as LinkedIn company URLs or numeric company IDs. A string or an array of up to 10 values.

group_url.description: Posts inside one LinkedIn group, as a group URL (linkedin.com/groups/...) or numeric group ID.

posted_within.description: 24h, week, and month are filtered by LinkedIn. 1h, 3months, 6months, and year are applied to each fetched page, so pages can hold fewer than 50 posts; they require sort_by date.

cursor.description: The opaque `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous page. Send it unchanged with the same filters as the first page.

200.description: A page of LinkedIn posts.

linkedin_url.description: Canonical LinkedIn profile or company URL.

feed_context.description: LinkedIn's feed label when the row is not a plain post by the author, such as "Example Person reposted this" or "Example Company collaborated on this". Null for a plain post.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when no further page is available.

total.description: Total matching posts reported by LinkedIn, or null when unavailable.

author.headline: Head of Sales at Example Company

400.description: Invalid JSON or body does not contain exactly one valid email field. Error bodies may vary. A failed verification is eligible for a refund; a 503 can mean the charge or refund could not be confirmed.

401.description: Missing or invalid bearer API key. Error bodies may vary. A failed verification is eligible for a refund; a 503 can mean the charge or refund could not be confirmed.

403.description: Insufficient credits. Error bodies may vary. A failed verification is eligible for a refund; a 503 can mean the charge or refund could not be confirmed.

413.description: JSON body exceeds 16 KiB. Error bodies may vary. A failed verification is eligible for a refund; a 503 can mean the charge or refund could not be confirmed.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred. Error bodies may vary. A failed verification is eligible for a refund; a 503 can mean the charge or refund could not be confirmed.

502.description: The verification request could not be completed. Error bodies may vary. A failed verification is eligible for a refund; a 503 can mean the charge or refund could not be confirmed.

503.description: The charge or refund could not be confirmed. Do not assume credits have been returned. Error bodies may vary. A failed verification is eligible for a refund; a 503 can mean the charge or refund could not be confirmed.

default.description: Other errors, such as 422, can have varying bodies. Failed verification requests are eligible for a refund. Successful responses can also contain non-object JSON or non-JSON content without a credits_consumed field.

post.description: Search with Leads Finder filters and zero-based page pagination. This filter model is different from Find people's query model.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 0.1 credits per returned lead. At least 0.1 credits are required to start.

filters.description: At least one non-empty filter other than searchMode is required. Use only the documented fields; some malformed legacy values are ignored by the runtime rather than rejected.

company.description: Company names, domains, or LinkedIn organization URLs. Invalid LinkedIn company URLs are rejected.

companyUrl.description: Company names, domains, or LinkedIn organization URLs. Invalid LinkedIn company URLs are rejected.

jobFunction.description: Job functions; at most 300 non-empty values after splitting.

jobFunctionExclude.description: Job functions; at most 300 non-empty values after splitting.

yearsCurrentRole.description: Current-role tenure, for example 1 to 2 years.

yearsCurrentCompany.description: Current-company tenure, for example 3 to 5 years.

yearsWorkExperience.description: Total experience, for example More than 10 years.

funding.description: Funding rounds, for example SEED or SERIES_A.

fundingAmount.description: Last funding amount range, for example 1000000-5000000.

fundingDateMonths.description: Funding lookback in months, for example 12.

department.description: Department and headcount range on separate lines, for example sales followed by 10-100.

growth.description: Department, growth range, and period on separate lines, for example sales, 20-80, and 3 months.

duration.description: Structured tenure bounds override the matching textual tenure field. Use non-negative integer years and months from 0 through 11.

latestCompany.description: When both bounds are present, min must not exceed max in total months.

currentCompany.description: When both bounds are present, min must not exceed max in total months.

previousCompany.description: When both bounds are present, min must not exceed max in total months.

latestJob.description: When both bounds are present, min must not exceed max in total months.

currentJob.description: When both bounds are present, min must not exceed max in total months.

previousJob.description: When both bounds are present, min must not exceed max in total months.

total.description: When both bounds are present, min must not exceed max in total months.

searchMode.description: Matching mode. Runtime falls back to SMART for an unrecognized value; use an explicit supported mode.

total.description: May be null when a reliable total is unavailable or company/title correlation removes rows.
